mentions.name: I-cut-you-choose poker variant videogame
mentions.description: A videogame built around a variant of poker with I-cut-you-choose mechanisms, featuring a meta plot and NPCs that remember the player and the way they play. Inspired by shuffle puck cafe and PC98 / Japanese bar table card games.
